from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseReference(BaseModel):
    """Identifying information for the legal case."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The case number, e.g., （2023）辽 0311 刑初 137 号")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court that issued the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named individual or entity involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party (e.g., 陈鸿华，新疆某旅游开发有限公司)")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Their role in the case (e.g., Appellant, Appellee, Applicant)")

class FinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """A monetary amount mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount, preserving formatting (e.g., 22000 元，11000 元)")
    description: str | None = Field(description="What the money is for (e.g., Case fee, Fine, Appraisal fee)")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who pays or is charged")

class Disposition(BaseModel):
    """The specific ruling or outcome described in the document."""
    text: str | None = Field(description="Full text of a specific ruling order")
    summary_label: str | None = Field(description="Short summary label of the disposition (e.g., 驳回上诉，准许撤回，维持原判)")
    is_final: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this judgment is final")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single legal judgment document."""
    case_references: list[CaseReference]
    parties: list[Party]
    financials: list[FinancialItem]
    dispositions: list[Disposition]
